experiment_data.hypothesis: 14B seed=44 candidate generation for 3-seed statistical robustness. Replicates plan017_14b_rsft_s43_generate parameters with seed=44 SFT adapter.

spec.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/autodl-tmp && HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 python -m freige.training.rsft_generate --base_model /root/autodl-tmp/models/Qwen/Qwen3-14B --sft_adapter /root/autodl-tmp/sft_output_14b_s44 --data_path /root/autodl-tmp/data/docred --output_dir /root/autodl-tmp/rsft_generations_14b_s44 --num_generations 8 --max_new_tokens 1024 --seed 44"
